, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the referenced “Ghost Rider” by linking to the 1949 Magazine Enterprises character rather than the Marvel Comics motorcycle character (Johnny Blaze) clearly implied by the song (“motorcycle hero”).
